requirements.text: Allow customers to book appointments online anytime
Implement automated reminders sent via SMS and email 24 hours and 1 hour before appointments
Provide barbers with the ability to manage their own schedules in real-time
Generate daily and weekly summaries including total bookings, cancellations, no-shows, peak times, and flagged repeat no-shows
Allow customers to cancel or reschedule their appointments easily without direct contact
Create a mobile-friendly interface for the booking system
Enforce a clear cancellation policy requiring a minimum 24-hour notice for cancellations, with a one-time grace period for first-time customers
